provenance.diagonal_quotient_argument: The q-minus-T degree is nonnegative on all generators. Its degree-zero sector contains only zero-jet slice coordinates. Casimir currents and positive jets have positive q-minus-T degree. Setting them to zero in each leading-T relation gives Jac(P_slice) and all restricted Casimirs. Conversely any coordinate-only leading term belongs to this ideal by evaluating its original relation at zero currents and positive jets. Thus the complete diagonal quotient is QQ[slice coordinates]/(Jac(P_slice), C_2,...,C_N).
